title_zh: 把博物馆应用演示限定为导览功能

scenario.label_zh: 把博物馆应用演示限定为导览功能
scenario.goal_zh: 区分现有导览界面与未完成的票务整合，并约定演示时明确标示票务尚未接通

context_zh: 博物馆产品团队准备展示应用原型，核对开发状态与演示范围。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Is this the integrated version of the museum app, with tickets and the audio tour together?

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Not yet. The tour interface works, but the ticketing integration is still being tested.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: The booking button looks active. Visitors might assume they can buy tickets through it.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Good catch. I'll disable it for the demo and label it 'Ticketing not connected'.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Can we still show the interactive map? It's an integral part of how visitors find each stop.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Yes. The map and audio work together. We can demonstrate those without opening the booking screen.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Then let's make this a tour-only demo and say clearly that ticketing isn't connected yet.

targets.sense_zh: 必不可少的、组成整体的重要部分的
